name: Lottery-Game-Graph-Chainlink-VRF
description: On-Chain random winner gets all type Grambling game using THE GRAPH and Chainlink's-VRF on Polygon Network.This dapp is a representation of automatic execution of randomness without any central authority. And it is super secure as there is no way to manipulate the results. Also in this app Graph protocol is used to get all the events.

paragraphs: In this game, there are two type of parties e.g. the host and the player. Host is the deployer of smart contract. Only the host can host a game. The host has the power to determine entry fees (which a player have to pay to play the game) and number of maximum players to participate. The players have to pay the fees that the host determined to enter the game. After all the players joining, the smart contract will randomly choose a winner using ChainLink VRF among the player. The winner will get all the fees that the other players submitted at the beginning of the game (including winners fees…
